title: Requirement explanations still claim structured evidence for unmapped courses

evidence.quote: if (result.laneMatches?.includes('requirement')) reasons.push('Requirement evidence came from structured mappings.');
it('does not claim requirement evidence for unmapped courses', () => {

reasoning: The match-evidence builder correctly refuses to add GenEd requirement evidence unless the course has a mapped GenEd, and the included test encodes that intent for an unmapped course. However, the explanation helpers still treat any `requirement` lane as structured requirement evidence, boosting confidence and adding a reason even when `course.gened` is null. The exact unmapped-course fixture in the test would still return an explanation reason saying requirement evidence came from structured mappings, and its confidence would be boosted from 0.74 to 0.82.
reproduction: Extend the existing unmapped-course test to inspect `dto.explanation?.confidence.reasons` and `dto.explanation?.confidence.label`; it will include the structured requirement reason and become `high` due to the unconditional +0.08 boost.
recommendation: Gate requirement confidence boosts and confidence reasons on the same condition used for requirement evidence, or derive them from the already-built evidence array so unmapped courses cannot claim structured requirement support.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing unmapped-course test checks only `match_evidence` labels and GenEd evidence. It does not assert `explanation.confidence.score`, `explanation.confidence.label`, or `explanation.confidence.reasons`.
suggestedRegressionTest: In `apps/api/src/dto/__tests__/course.test.ts`, extend the unmapped requirement-lane case to assert that confidence reasons do not contain `Requirement evidence came from structured mappings.` and that the confidence score is not boosted by the requirement lane.
minimumFixScope: Update `apps/api/src/dto/course.ts` explanation confidence helpers, or pass requirement-evidence presence from `buildResultExplanation` into those helpers.
